shortDescription: Backup/Restore the configuration of the VIOS

options.name: action
options.description: Specifies the operation to perform on the VIOS. C(backup) to perform a backup. C(restore) to restore a backup file. C(recoverdb) to recover from a corrupted shared storage pool (SSP) database. C(migrate) to migrate a backup file from an older release level to a current release level. A new file is created with C(_MIGRATED) string appended to the given file name. C(dr) to recover the cluster on another geographic location. C(list) to view the listing of backup files. C(view) to view a backup file

options.name: clustername
options.description: Specifies the cluster name to back up or restore, including all of its associated nodes.

options.name: currentdb
options.description: Restores the cluster without restoring the database from the backup. When restoring mapping, some of the mapping can fail if the mappings are not in the current database.

options.name: devtype
options.description: Only restore devices of the specified type.

options.name: dir
options.description: User-specified location from where to list backup files when I(action=list).

options.name: file
options.description: Specifies the file name of the file that has backup information. For backup, compressed file is created with C(.tar.gz) extension. For cluster backups, compressed file is created with C(<clustername>.tar.gz) extension. If file name is a relative path, file is created under C(/home/padmin/cfgbackups).

options.name: force
options.description: Attempts to restore a device even if it has not been successfully validated.

options.name: mapping
options.description: Displays mapping information for SEA, virtual SCSI adapters, VFC adapters, and PowerVM Active Memory Sharing paging devices.

options.name: repopvs
options.description: List of hdisks to be used as repository disks for restoring the cluster. The given disks must not contain a repository signature.

options.name: skipcluster
options.description: Restores all local devices, except I(cluster0).

options.name: skipdevattr
options.description: Skips the restore of the physical device attributes. Does not modify the current system's physical device attributes.

options.name: subfile
options.description: Specifies the node configuration file to be restored.

options.name: validate
options.description: Validates the devices on the server against the devices on the backed-up file. Fails the restore operation if items do not validate successfully.

options.name: view_backup_file
options.description: Specifies the file name of the file which user wants to view information about.
